# Most Played on SnackArcade — 2026-08-04

This post lists the game pages that were viewed the most during the latest reporting period. The list is built from the ga4-manual-export exported on 2026-08-04, and it is a data summary only — it contains no opinion and no strategy advice. Every game below runs directly in the browser with no download and no sign-up.

## 1. 2048

[Play 2048](/games/2048/) — 2048 is the sliding tile puzzle that ate the internet in 2014 and never really let go.

This page was played 1250 times during the reporting period.

Read the full guide: [2048 guide and controls](/games/2048/)

## How This List Was Made

The rankings come from a manual export of the site's Google Analytics 4 report, saved to the popular data file on 2026-08-04. The export is refreshed periodically, and this post is only generated while the export is recent. When the data is old, missing or empty, no leaderboard post is created at all — the site never invents numbers.
